subject: Invoice signature stamp, PDF stub and delivery route (email vs portal)
messages:
From: Sophie Alvarez <sophie@aeronova.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: AP Team <ap@aeronova.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice signature stamp, PDF stub and delivery route

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. A quick question from our AP team: when Redwood issues invoices, can you provide a signed/stamped PDF copy (we need the stamp for our internal invoice stamping audit) and also include a short invoice stub in the body (invoice number, net due, PO reference) so our mailbox parser can auto-ingest?

We have two integration options on our side:
- Preferred: portal push + webhook that posts a JSON invoice and then emails ap@aeronova.com a copy for archive.
- Fallback: send a signed PDF to ap@aeronova.com and include an HTML stub in the email body.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Attach a stamped PDF (signed by Redwood) to the outbound invoice email?
2) Add a small HTML/inline stub for parser ingestion?
3) Emit the same signed PDF to the portal as part of the invoice object so our webhook can fetch it?

I attached our EIN for billing records. If there are policy or security concerns around embedded signatures, please let us know.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Alvarez
Head of Finance, AeroNova
AP: ap@aeronova.com

Attachment: aeronova-ein.pdf
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Alvarez <sophie@aeronova.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@aeronova.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice signature stamp, PDF stub and delivery route

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the EIN. Happy to confirm options and the constraints so your team can pick the flow that best fits your ingestion. Short answers first: yes, yes, and yes — with caveats below.

Details:
- Signed/stamped PDF: We can attach a PDF that includes a Redwood signature stamp (automated PAdES-like visual stamp). For security/audit reasons the PDF is generated by our billing pipeline and the visual stamp is a controlled asset; we do not embed private keys client-side. If you require cryptographic signing (x509) rather than a visual stamp, we can discuss an add-on (requires signing cert & additional compliance steps).

- Inline HTML stub: We can include a minimal invoice stub at the top of the email body (invoice number, date, PO ref, due date, net amount). We'll keep it machine-friendly (simple table + data attributes) so your mailbox parser can consume it reliably.

- Portal object + webhook: When you opt into portal push, the invoice object includes a URL to download the signed PDF. Our webhook payload (JSON) will include the download link and a sha256 checksum. If you'd rather have the PDF POSTed to your endpoint, we can support that under a secured transfer agreement (needs a short connectivity checklist).

Operational notes:
- Delivery patterns: Portal-first flow keeps receipts centralized and gives guaranteed idempotency (we can re-emit PDFs if you request replays). Email-only flow is subject to mailbox delivery SLAs and may require retries on bounce.
- Retention: The portal copy is retained per our standard 7-year retention policy unless you request shorter archival windows.
- Mapping: Please provide the exact parser field names for the stub (e.g., invoice_id, po_number, net_amount) and we'll lock mapping into the template.

Connor and Kimberly — looping you in for implementation details and to confirm if we need to route the signed asset to a secured S3 bucket for AeroNova webhook pulls.

Sincerely,
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sophie Alvarez <sophie@aeronova.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice signature stamp, PDF stub and delivery route

Laura / Sophie — quick technical follow-up on the PDF delivery options. Summary of choices we should confirm:

Option A (Portal-first, recommended):
- Redwood pushes invoice object to portal; portal stores signed PDF, exposes download URL.
- We send webhook to AeroNova with JSON payload: invoice_id, download_url, sha256, issued_at, due_at.
- We also send email copy to ap@aeronova.com with the inline stub (no attachment) — keeps mailbox archive in sync.

Option B (Email-first, fallback):
- Redwood sends signed PDF as attachment to ap@aeronova.com and a copy to the portal.
- Email uses a compact HTML stub (parser-friendly) and subject prefix [INVOICE].

Implementation notes:
- For Option A webhook: we'll need a TLS endpoint and a shared HMAC secret (we can rotate keys quarterly).
- For Option B email parsing: we'll add data attributes to the stub table, and include an invoice metadata header (X-Redwood-Invoice-ID: RWD-20270404-XXXX) so your parser can prefer headers if necessary.

Kimberly — can you confirm whether we can include the visual stamp as part of the standard billing pipeline or whether the customer needs the cryptographic cert option (chargeable)? Also, if we send emails to ap@aeronova.com, do we need to cc a billing-archive mailbox?

Connor O'Brien
Billing Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Alvarez <sophie@aeronova.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice signature stamp, PDF stub and delivery route

Hi Sophie — thanks, this is straightforward. Confirming Redwood can do Option A (portal-first) as your primary flow. A few final items from AP compliance:

1) Please confirm the exact PO field name you send in your PO emails (we map po_number -> po_ref by default).
2) Do you require the stamped PDF to contain the issuer name line in a specific font or placement? We can accept a one-page sample requirement but prefer to keep the stamp in the footer for consistency.
3) For archive copies: we'll cc billing-archive@redwood.com on the notification email so we have a copy in our long-term retention. If AeroNova prefers not to receive the cc, let us know.

Next steps:
- Sophie: reply with parser field names and whether you want the PDF attached to the email in addition to portal link (Option B fallback).
- Laura/Connor: I'll flip the ticket to implementation and create the webhook HMAC secret after we get the endpoint.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
